what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from India in Australia: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7815 Indian asylum seekers in Australia, 4.3% of all asylum seekers from India.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kashmir territory in India from 1995 to 2025, and over the government of India from 1996 to 2025.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 874 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 12278, at the end of 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Australia.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Australia only.
